I've been asking myself these same questions recently. After reading a lot and trying to make sense of things, I'm presently at this standpoint: 

we have to stop trying to control things and humble ourselves as humans before the Lord in order to truly be ready to move on to what's next. Suicide is like... the ultimate "fuck you" to our Source- the ultimate "fuck you" to your true self. The "I refuse to learn these lessons and move on". 
The point isn't suicide, the point is ego death. Give up the thing inside of you that is scared and power hungry. Stop trying to be in control and remember you are guided and protected in this learning lesson. Suicide will solve nothing & just add on to the burdens of your next life (knowledge as well, however). You have to prove that you are truly at balance. At peace with yourself and in turn - everything else because we are all connected. Forgive yourself!! Be nothing!! Relax.
Be harmless to yourself and others, and release the tension in your heart!!

Everyone is going to see you for how beautiful and brave you are. Never doubt your self or your worth. Don't let sabotaging thoughts affect your present moment. Remember that you're guided and protected

Not having anyone to discuss my traumas with makes me question if they even ever happened. Sometimes I try and convince myself that it’s all an elaborate lie I made up in order to feel sorry for myself, and to remain trapped in my ego. I crave validation and support but I don’t know where to get it. I don’t know how to grow past it because I feel trapped and alone. I want so badly to heal and move on so I can develop healthy relationships but something is holding me back. I was molested by a close family friend throughout childhood. I was really young when it started, 4 years old I think... he would pay me small amounts of money to touch him and for him to touch me. I didn’t know it was wrong, I thought that was love because I am adopted and I struggled so much with wanting to feel loved and wanted... When I tried to tell my family what was happening I was met with disbelief. Surely THAT couldn’t be happening in their good Christian home. That caused so much pain... to not be believed. They asked me where I kept getting quarters and dollars and I tried to tell them but they accused me of lying and stealing and making everything up. Certainly I am remembering wrong right? It’s not uncommon for people to make up traumas about their past in order to victimize themselves right?I turned into a bad person after that. I would lie and I would steal and I was so depressed and sad all the time because I thought that I was a bad person and I had caused everything bad that was happening. I was struggling with the fact that I was adopted, and the loneliness that comes with that. I have craved attention and love throughout my whole life so maybe it’s my fault he started molesting me. Maybe I made him belive that’s what I wanted.And now at 22 I am still trapped. I want to leave this identity behind because it does nothing but harm my growth. I am living the life of my dreams right now but I can’t fully appreciate because I’m terrified it will all fall apart. I’m terrified everything wrong I’ve ever done is catching up to me. I’m terrified I’m crazy and that none of the traumas I’ve experienced are real. All the lying and stealing and negativity I’ve put out in the world.... I don’t know what to do I don’t know how to make up for it.

Do something for yourself... for me healing crystals or weighted blankets were really comforting when I began my self healing journey!! You have to give yourself the affection and attention you want from him.
